corrections.text: The article states that Red Hat "labels it 'Important' in its own severity scale." Red Hat's CVE page for CVE-2026-114938 does not use the word "Important" as a severity rating anywhere (the only occurrence of that word on the page is the heading of an unrelated FAQ note about CVSS score variance); the page's own severity field for this CVE records it as "CRITICAL," consistent with Red Hat's four-tier scale, where its 9.8 base score falls in the Critical band.
